title: LocalReasoningFailure
description: Records a local-first reasoning failure: a case where a model-derived value was presented as authoritative for an exactness-sensitive field, or where stale/contaminated context produced an incorrect output. Links to repair evidence and prevents the failure from being silently overwritten.

id.description: URN of this failure record. Format: urn:srcos:local-reasoning-failure:<slug>

affectedObjectRef.description: URN of the object or artifact affected by the failure.

affectedField.description: Specific field within the object that contains the erroneous value.

incorrectValue.description: The model-derived or stale value that was incorrectly admitted.

expectedValueHint.description: The correct value if known, or a pointer to where it can be determined.

detectedBy.description: Component or verifier that detected the failure.

contextHydrationBoundary.description: Memory/context hydration boundary metadata — what context was in scope when the failure occurred.

repairPlanRef.description: URN of repair plan that addresses this failure.

verifierRef.description: URN of the deterministic verifier that confirmed the failure.

sourceChannelRef.description: URN of the SourceChannelEnvelope that carried this failure for propagation.

suppressMutation.description: When true, downstream components must not apply the incorrect value to durable state.
